pages.title: Rosalina in a Sporty Jacket Making a Peace Sign Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Rosalina flashing a peace sign, wearing sunglasses on her head, a sporty jacket with a lightning emblem, and a star-shaped earring.

pages.title: Princess Rosalina with Luma and Stars Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Princess Rosalina posing in her elegant gown with a jeweled crown, star-shaped brooch, dangling earrings, and a smiling Luma surrounded by stars.

pages.title: Chibi Rosalina Wearing Her Crown and Smiling Beneath Stars Coloring Page
pages.description: Chibi Rosalina smiles beneath a cluster of stars in this printable coloring page, wearing a large pointed crown above the sweeping fringe that covers one eye. Her small figure has a star brooch, flared cuffs, a long layered dress, and a dangling star earring against a plain background.

pages.title: Rosalina Holding Luma Beneath a Starry Sky Coloring Page
pages.description: Rosalina holds Luma beneath a starry sky in this printable coloring page, smiling gently as she supports the small star-shaped companion with both of her hands. A crescent moon and outlined stars surround her crown, while her long gown, star brooch, and curled hair fill the foreground.

pages.title: Rosalina Holding a Glowing Star in a Galaxy Coloring Page
pages.description: Rosalina holds a glowing star in a galaxy in this printable coloring page, cupping her hands below its pointed shape and the short rays around it. Sweeping spiral galaxies and patterned planets frame the close portrait, with her crown, side-swept fringe, and star earring clearly outlined.

pages.title: Rosalina Standing with Luma Beneath Stars Coloring Page
pages.description: Rosalina stands with Luma beneath stars in this printable coloring page, holding her wand low beside a long gown covered with scattered five-pointed star shapes. Luma floats near her shoulder beneath a crescent moon, while small stones and grass tufts mark the curved ground below her dress.

pages.title: Halloween Rosalina Dressed as a Witch Flying Above Pumpkins Coloring Page
pages.description: Halloween Rosalina flies above pumpkins dressed as a witch in this printable coloring page, sitting on a broomstick with both hands around its long handle. A tall bent hat rises above her side-swept hair, and the broom's broad bristles extend behind her gown over a crowded pumpkin patch.

pages.title: Rosalina Spinning Beneath Star-shaped Sparkles Coloring Page
pages.description: Rosalina spins beneath star-shaped sparkles in this printable coloring page, smiling with closed eyes as she stretches both arms outward and her skirt sweeps around her. Curved motion lines, dots, rings, and pointed sparkles encircle her crown, flowing hair, star earring, and flared sleeve cuffs.

pages.title: Rosalina Riding a Motorcycle with Luma on a Mario Kart Track Coloring Page
pages.description: Rosalina rides a motorcycle with Luma on a Mario Kart track in this printable coloring page, gripping the handlebars while her star-shaped companion floats beside her. Her fitted riding outfit, gloves, boots, and crown appear above the bike's exposed engine and thick tires as the course curves away.

pages.title: Rosalina Flying Through Space with Luma Coloring Page
pages.description: Rosalina flies through space with Luma in this printable coloring page, spreading her hands while her long gown and flowing hair sweep behind her floating figure. Outlined stars and dotted constellation patterns surround the pair, with her crown, star brooch, earrings, and scalloped cuffs adding smaller details.

pages.title: Rosalina Casting Star-shaped Magic with Her Star Wand Coloring Page
pages.description: Rosalina casts star-shaped magic with her star wand in this printable coloring page, raising it high above one shoulder as her other hand reaches outward. A curling stream of stars and long curved trails surrounds her crown and wide-sleeved gown, with larger stars scattered across the background.

pages.title: Kawaii Baby Rosalina Posing Beneath Stars Coloring Page
pages.description: Kawaii Baby Rosalina poses beneath stars in this printable coloring page, lifting one hand beside her smiling face and holding the other open near her shoulder. Her small crown, star-decorated dress, puffed shorts, frilled socks, and rounded shoes sit below a crescent moon and scattered sparkles.

pages.title: Rosalina Playing a Handheld Video Game in a Room Coloring Page
pages.description: Rosalina plays a handheld video game in a room in this printable coloring page, sitting on a chair with the open console held in both hands. Her long gown spreads toward the floor beneath her star brooch, while a tall window and a leafy potted plant flank the seat.

pages.title: Chibi Princess Rosalina Floating in the Sky with Luma Coloring Page
pages.description: Chibi Princess Rosalina floats in the sky with Luma in this printable coloring page, holding her arms out while her small shoes hang below her sweeping dress. Large clouds and scattered stars surround her oversized head and crown, with a smiling Luma floating directly beneath her.

pages.title: Rosalina Posing with Luma and Stars in the Background Coloring Page
pages.description: Rosalina poses with Luma and stars in the background in this printable coloring page, holding a star-tipped wand angled downward beside her long, wide-sleeved gown. Luma smiles near her shoulder, while her pointed crown, sweeping fringe, star earring, and matching brooch define the close full-height composition.

pages.title: Rosalina Flying in the Sky with Luma Coloring Page
pages.description: Rosalina flies in the sky with Luma in this printable coloring page, reaching one arm forward as her hair and long gown sweep behind her. Stars decorate her bodice and the surrounding sky, while small sparkles trail beneath Luma between the soft outlines of nearby clouds.

pages.title: Rosalina Looking Through a Telescope at a Galaxy Coloring Page
pages.description: Rosalina looks through a telescope at a galaxy in this printable coloring page, standing beside its tall tripod with her hands near the lower eyepiece. A broad arched opening reveals spiral galaxies, ringed planets, a crescent moon, and constellations above the stars scattered across her long gown.

pages.title: Anime Rosalina Holding Up Her Star Wand in a Galaxy Coloring Page
pages.description: Anime Rosalina holds up her star wand in a galaxy in this printable coloring page, smiling beneath her crown while her free hand opens beside her gown. A bow decorates the wand below its layered star tip, surrounded by a crescent moon, ringed planets, stars, and a shooting star.

pages.title: Chibi Rosalina Holding a Star Wand Beneath Stars Coloring Page
pages.description: Chibi Rosalina holds a star wand beneath stars in this printable coloring page, standing inside a rectangular border with her free hand extended beside her dress. Short rays surround the wand's pointed tip, while a star hair ornament, crown, star brooch, and rounded shoes add details to her small figure.

pages.title: Rosalina Smiling and Waving Beneath Shooting Stars Coloring Page
pages.description: Rosalina smiles and waves beneath shooting stars in this printable coloring page, lifting one hand high while holding her star-tipped wand low beside her gown. Three large shooting stars cross the sky on curved trails dotted with smaller stars and sparkles above a crescent moon.

pages.title: Rosalina Playing Tennis with a Racket and Ball on a Tennis Court Coloring Page
pages.description: Rosalina plays tennis with a racket and ball on a tennis court in this printable coloring page, stepping forward with her free arm stretched behind her. Her collared sports dress carries a star emblem beneath her crown, while the racket's string grid echoes the net crossing the court.

pages.title: Rosalina Reading a Storybook to Luma in a Library Coloring Page
pages.description: Rosalina reads a storybook to Luma in a library in this printable coloring page, sitting in an armchair with the open book resting above her gown. Luma smiles beside the book's illustrated cover, with filled shelves, an oval rug, and a moon-and-stars window completing the room.

pages.title: Rosalina Wearing a Sparkling Dress Beneath Stars Coloring Page
pages.description: Rosalina wears a sparkling dress beneath stars in this printable coloring page, facing forward with open hands beside the flared sleeves of her long gown. Stars, pointed sparkles, and curling patterns decorate the skirt, while sweeping trails and scattered celestial shapes surround her crown and flowing hair.

pages.title: Rosalina Riding a Bike with Luma on a Mario Kart Track Coloring Page
pages.description: Rosalina rides a bike with Luma on a Mario Kart track in this printable coloring page, holding the handlebars while Luma sits in the front basket. Her long dress curves around the bicycle frame as large spotted mushrooms, stars, and brick blocks line the bending course.

pages.title: Kawaii Rosalina Holding Luma Beneath Stars Coloring Page
pages.description: Kawaii Rosalina holds Luma beneath stars in this printable coloring page, cradling the smiling star-shaped companion near her chest with her hands beneath its rounded points. Stars also decorate her crown and the lower panels of her gown, below a crescent moon and a densely scattered starry sky.

pages.title: Rosalina Flying with Outstretched Arms Above Clouds Coloring Page
pages.description: Rosalina flies with outstretched arms above clouds in this printable coloring page, smiling as her long hair and broad skirt stream behind her floating figure. Her pointed crown, star earrings, matching brooch, and rippling sleeve cuffs stand out above the overlapping cloud banks filling the lower background.

pages.title: Rosalina Racing a Kart Beneath a Starry Sky Coloring Page
pages.description: Rosalina races a kart beneath a starry sky in this printable coloring page, gripping the steering wheel while wearing a striped helmet topped with her crown. The front-facing kart has wide tires, a broad bumper, and a large round nose panel beneath oversized stars and a crescent moon.

pages.title: Rosalina Wearing a Tennis Dress and Crown on a Tennis Court Coloring Page
pages.description: Rosalina wears a tennis dress and crown on a tennis court in this printable coloring page, gripping a large racket with both hands in front of her. A star emblem decorates her collared outfit above strapped shoes, with court lines, a rear barrier, and a rectangular border framing the pose.

pages.title: Rosalina Holding Her Star Wand in a Super Smash Bros Battle Arena Coloring Page
pages.description: Rosalina holds her star wand in a Super Smash Bros battle arena in this printable coloring page, standing with her free hand open beside her gown. Floating ledges, stacked platform shapes, and a large spotted mushroom form the background behind her crown, star earring, and matching brooch.

pages.title: Rosalina Posing with Her Side-swept Hair Covering One Eye Beneath Stars Coloring Page
pages.description: Rosalina poses beneath stars with her side-swept hair covering one eye in this printable coloring page, smiling gently below the points of her jeweled crown. Large stars arc above the close portrait, echoing the star patterns on her bodice and sleeves, her brooch, and her dangling earring.

pages.title: Tanooki Rosalina Gliding Above a Platform with Pipes and Blocks Coloring Page
pages.description: Tanooki Rosalina glides above a platform with pipes and blocks in this printable coloring page, spreading both arms as her feet trail behind her airborne figure. Her animal-eared hood, oval belly patch, broad underarm panels, and striped tail contrast with the straight edges of the structures below.

pages.title: Rosalina Wearing Her Super Smash Bros Dress in a Battle Arena Coloring Page
pages.description: Rosalina wears her Super Smash Bros dress in a battle arena in this printable coloring page, standing between columns with her hands open beside her skirt. Layered gown panels, stars at her hair and waist, flared cuffs, and her crown appear within an ornate star-and-scroll border.

pages.title: Rosalina Playing a Video Game with Luma Watching Coloring Page
pages.description: Rosalina plays a video game with Luma watching in this printable coloring page, sitting in a swivel chair and holding a controller above her star-patterned skirt. Luma floats beside a screen showing mountains and platforms, with a console on the desk beneath her crown and long hair.

pages.title: Baby Rosalina Standing Beneath Stars Coloring Page
pages.description: Baby Rosalina stands beneath stars in this printable coloring page, smiling with her hands folded in front of a short dress decorated with a star brooch. Her oversized fringe, pointed crown, puffed sleeves, frilled shorts, and small shoes appear among stars and crescent moons of different sizes.

pages.title: Rosalina Holding Her Star Wand in a Galaxy Coloring Page
pages.description: Rosalina holds her star wand in a galaxy in this printable coloring page, carrying it diagonally across her body with ribbon tails hanging below its tip. Stars cover the lower portion of her gown, while crescent moons, shooting stars, and small spirals surround her crown and curled hair.

pages.title: Rosalina Wearing a Wedding Dress with Luma Beneath Stars Coloring Page
pages.description: Rosalina wears a wedding dress with Luma beneath stars in this printable coloring page, folding her gloved hands in front of the gown's broad layered skirt. Flowers and hearts decorate its panels and veil, while Luma floats amid sparkles near the hem beneath a small crescent moon.

pages.title: Rosalina Floating with a Grand Star in Space Coloring Page
pages.description: Rosalina floats with a Grand Star in space in this printable coloring page, holding the large double-outlined star while her shoes hang below her flowing gown. Long rays surround the star's points, with smaller stars, dots, and a ringed planet scattered around her crowned figure.

pages.title: Rosalina Holding a 1-up Mushroom in a Mario World Coloring Page
pages.description: Rosalina holds a 1-Up Mushroom in a Mario world in this printable coloring page, balancing its spotted cap above an open palm beside her smiling face. Her long gown and flared sleeve cuffs fill the foreground, backed by outlined stars and rounded hills with wavy upper bands.

pages.title: Rosalina Driving a Mario Kart 8 Kart on a Racetrack Coloring Page
pages.description: Rosalina drives a Mario Kart 8 kart on a racetrack in this printable coloring page, holding the wheel while wearing a fitted outfit decorated with stars. A star emblem also marks the kart's nose, with question blocks, palm trees, rounded hills, and oversized mushrooms along the course behind her.

pages.title: Rosalina Dancing with Luma Beneath Stars Coloring Page
pages.description: Rosalina dances with Luma beneath stars in this printable coloring page, reaching one hand toward her floating companion as her long hair and wide skirt swing outward. Scattered stars decorate the lower gown panels, echoing the larger stars and crescent moon arranged in the sky overhead.

pages.title: Rosalina Driving a Racing Kart on a Mario Kart Track Coloring Page
pages.description: Rosalina drives a racing kart on a Mario Kart track in this printable coloring page, smiling as she steers around a bend near a distant castle. Her star-covered racing suit appears above a kart with treaded tires, a broad front bumper, and a raised rear wing beside the guardrail.

pages.title: Rosalina Standing with Her Crown and Dress Beneath a Starry Sky Coloring Page
pages.description: Rosalina stands with her crown and dress beneath a starry sky in this printable coloring page, holding both hands loosely open beside her long, curved-hem gown. A crescent moon and scattered stars frame her side-swept hair, star earring, puffed shoulders, and flared cuffs above a horizon of rounded hills.

pages.title: Princess Rosalina Floating Among Stars and Clouds Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Rosalina floats among stars and clouds in this printable coloring page, extending both hands while a small Luma hovers above one of her palms. Stars and a curved trail decorate her sweeping gown, with pointed sparkles and rounded clouds surrounding her crown, curled hair, and dangling shoes.

pages.title: Cat Rosalina Climbing a Platform with Pipes and Blocks Coloring Page
pages.description: Cat Rosalina climbs a platform with pipes and blocks in this printable coloring page, gripping the edge of a stone wall with her oversized paw gloves. Her pointed cat ears, curled tail, and paw-shaped boots appear beside a tall pipe, a small lower block, and a floating question block.

pages.title: Kawaii Rosalina Wearing Her Crown and Holding a Star Wand Beneath Stars Coloring Page
pages.description: Kawaii Rosalina wears her crown and holds a star wand beneath stars in this printable coloring page, carrying its long shaft diagonally across her plain gown. Ribbon tails hang below the outlined star tip, while a crescent moon and four stars arc above her sweeping fringe and curled hair.

pages.title: Baby Rosalina Driving a Mario Kart on a Racetrack Coloring Page
pages.description: Baby Rosalina drives a Mario Kart on a racetrack in this printable coloring page, smiling above the wheel of a small kart with a star emblem. Her star-covered outfit and pointed crown stand out against treaded tires, lane markings, rounded hills, and a checkered banner over the distant course.

pages.title: Rosalina Floating in Space Beneath Stars Coloring Page
pages.description: Rosalina floats in space beneath stars in this printable coloring page, raising one hand near her star brooch while holding the other open beside her gown. Her hair sweeps sideways below her crown, and the curved skirt panels reveal a scalloped underskirt beneath the stars scattered overhead.

pages.title: Rosalina Wearing Her Detailed Gown and Crown in a Starry Sky Coloring Page
pages.description: Rosalina wears her detailed gown and crown in a starry sky in this printable coloring page, standing with relaxed hands beside the broad cuffs of her sleeves. Large stars decorate the lower skirt, while smaller stars and pointed sparkles frame her long fringe, curled hair, and dangling star earring.

pages.title: Rosalina Standing Beside a Launch Star in a Galaxy Coloring Page
Rosalina Wearing a Long Gown and Holding Her Star Wand with Luma Beneath Stars Coloring Page
pages.description: Rosalina wears a long gown and holds her star wand with Luma beneath stars in this printable coloring page, keeping her free hand open at her side. Luma floats near the lower skirt, while the raised wand, star brooch, flared cuffs, and sweeping hair define the simple full-length portrait.

pages.title: Baby Rosalina Driving a Rounded Kart on a Racetrack Coloring Page
pages.description: Baby Rosalina drives a rounded kart on a racetrack in this printable coloring page, holding its steering wheel with both hands beneath her large pointed crown. A smooth round nose panel, thick tires, and rear exhaust surround her seat, with flowers, grass tufts, and a checkered flag beside the bend.

pages.title: Rosalina Raising Her Star Wand Beneath Stars Coloring Page
pages.description: Rosalina raises her star wand beneath stars in this printable coloring page, lifting it above her crowned head while her free hand opens beside her long gown. A star decorates the center of her crown, echoed by her brooch, dangling earring, and the surrounding stars near a crescent moon.

pages.title: Mario Rosalina in Toad Town Coloring Page
pages.description: Rosalina stands with Mario in Toad Town in this printable coloring page, holding her star-tipped wand low beside a long gown patterned with scattered stars. Mushroom houses, a lamp post, stepping stones, and a small Toad line the street behind her crown and Mario's cap and overalls.

pages.title: Mario Rosalina in Outer Space Coloring Page
pages.description: Rosalina appears with Mario in outer space in this printable coloring page, the pair smiling side by side beneath a crescent moon and a ringed planet. Her pointed crown, star brooch, long fringe, and wide sleeve cuffs contrast with his M cap, gloves, mustache, and buttoned overalls.

pages.title: Mario Rosalina in Ice Cave Coloring Page
pages.description: Rosalina stands with Mario in an ice cave in this printable coloring page, holding a star wand beside his winter coat and flower-emblem cap beneath pointed icicles. Crystal clusters and cracks cover the cavern floor, while angular icy walls surround her crown, long gown, and star earring.

pages.title: Mario Rosalina in Castle Courtyard Coloring Page
pages.description: Rosalina joins Mario in a castle courtyard in this printable coloring page, holding her star wand across her long gown beside his cap, gloves, and overalls. A broad stone path leads behind the pair to an arched castle doorway, with pointed towers, patterned windows, shrubs, and flowers nearby.

pages.title: Mario Rosalina in Dinosaur Land Coloring Page
pages.description: Rosalina poses with Mario in Dinosaur Land in this printable coloring page, holding her wand beside her gown while he gives two thumbs up in front of her. A Dinosaur Land sign, palm trees, flowers, Yoshi, and a distant long-necked dinosaur fill the landscape behind the pair.
